data_description.source: The service that provides the showtimes of the cinema.

cinema.title: Add a cinema
cinema.description: Showtimes come from {source_name}. Enter the cinema's reference, such as `{ref_example}`, or the address of its page, such as `{url_example}`.

data_description.cinema_id: The cinema's reference at the source, or the address of its page.
data_description.name: Optional. The name shown for this cinema in Home Assistant. Defaults to the source name followed by the cinema reference.

error.invalid_cinema_id: Invalid or unknown cinema. Check the reference you entered.
error.access_denied: The site refused the request. Try again later.

cannot_connect.message: Could not reach {source} to fetch the showtimes.

access_denied.message: {source} refused the request (HTTP {status}). The showtimes will be fetched again later.

invalid_response.message: {source} returned showtimes in an unexpected format. The site may have changed.

unknown_source.message: This entry uses the source {source}, which this version of the integration does not provide.
